description: Provision a Google Cloud Tags TagsTagValue via Config Connector. Fields mirror the tags.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 TagsTagValue spec.

description.description:
Optional. User-assigned description of the TagValue.
 Must not exceed 256 characters.

 Read-write.

parentRef.description: Immutable. The TagValue's parent TagKey. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed TagsTagKey resource. Should be in the format "tagKeys/{{tagKeyID}}".

name.description: The name of a TagsTagKey resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a TagsTagKey resource.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The service-generated name of the resource. Used for acquisition only. Leave unset to create a new resource.

shortName.description:
Required. Immutable. User-assigned short name for TagValue. The short name
 should be unique for TagValues within the same parent TagKey.

 The short name must be 63 characters or less, beginning and ending with
 an alphanumeric character ([a-z0-9A-Z]) with dashes (-), underscores (_),
 dots (.), and alphanumerics between.
